data_dictionary.none_state: NONE means the strategic base is destroyed or demolished and has not been rebuilt by either faction; it is effectively no-man's-land.
data_dictionary.rate_trends: Adjacent equal-window comparison. Array order is [recent_per_hour, previous_per_hour, change_per_hour, direction].
data_dictionary.recent_events: A direct ownership flip can produce a loss row plus a capture row for the same state transition.
data_dictionary.selected_metrics: Evidence citation keys whose values and observation times are frozen at prediction time.
data_dictionary.total_enlistments: Cumulative unique players who have deployed to this region during the war. A player can count in multiple regions. This is not current population or a faction split; its change is only a new-to-that-region activity proxy.

previous_model_summary.headline: Weathered Expanse Reignites as Mooring County Heats
previous_model_summary.war_summary: Since the morning edition the weight of action has shifted to Weathered Expanse, which counts five changes in the last two hours and forty-one on the day about Frostmarch, Crow's Nest and Shattered Advance to the filing minute, standing four Warden to five Colonial with day losses near fourteen thousand Colonial and seventeen thousand Warden and rates quickening sharply. Mooring County has quickened alongside with three changes in two hours and twenty-two on the day about the Wind Hills and Wiccwalk, holding eleven Warden to one Colonial with losses above five thousand Colonial and four thousand Warden. Fisherman's Row has eased to two changes in two hours, though fifty-two on the day about Eidolo, Black Well and Arcadia keep it active at two Warden to six Colonial with one destroyed. Godcrofts shows two fresh changes about Argosa and Lipsia. Stlican Shelf, Farranac Coast and Linn Mercy have gone quiet in the last two hours, last heard near half past nine, ten past nine and ten past eight, while Callahan's Passage reports no fresh flip despite day losses above ten thousand Colonial and eight thousand Warden.
